feeds.title: The Suits of James Bond » Tailoring
feeds.description: Matt Spaiser is a graphic designer located in New York. After years of research, he founded The Suits of James Bond in 2010, creating the ultimate resource for James Bond style and the first catalogue of all of 007's outfits.

feeds.title: Senszio Traveling Tailors
feeds.description: Senszio is the perfect marriage of tradition and forward fashion - the fine art of tailoring delivered with a contemporary twist. At Senszio, the quality of your bespoke suit is ensured by a team of four highly experienced specialists. Read the Senszio Briefing, the modern gentleman's guide to choosing a perfectly-fitted suit, the pleasures of custom tailoring, and how to style your garments.

feeds.title: Sartorial Castle Blog
feeds.description: Learn the intricacies of bespoke craftsmanship with Sartorial Castle's articles on tailored suites and styles. Sartorial Castle is a Dubai-based store that provides you with great suits that are made from the highest quality fabrics and guaranteed to give you functionality, durability and comfort.

feeds.title: Articles of Style
feeds.description: Articles of Style provides an online bespoke menswear service for gentlemen of all shapes & sizes who want to improve their style and live their best lives.

feeds.title: The Savile Row Tailor Blog
feeds.description: Steven Hitchcock is an independent Savile Row tailor at the forefront of luxurious soft tailoring, a craft passed on to him by his father John Hitchcock. Steven has made suits for rockstars Michelin star chefs and his most famous client H.R.H. In this blog you will find posts on traditional tailoring, bespoke hand cut suits, cloths and fitting guides.

feeds.title: Off The Cuff
feeds.description: A Bespoke Fashion Blog bringing you weekly news straight from the cutting table on all things custom-made & bespoke. From style icons to the Graham Norton Show & its guests. A Hand Tailored Suit creates bespoke custom garments for Men & Women. We source only the finest of cloth from only the finest of cloth merchant.

feeds.title: De Oost Bespoke Tailoring Blog
feeds.description: De Oost Bespoke Tailoring. We tailor quality suits, shirts, jackets for ladies & gentlemen in Amsterdam.

feeds.title: Garrison Bespoke
feeds.description: Garrison Bespoke specializes in custom made tailored suits, shirts & formal wear. The Journal is constantly being updated to incorporate the latest custom suits bespoke suits and made-to-measure suits. Please post your thoughts.

feeds.title: Tailor On Ten
feeds.description: Tailor On Ten is a bespoke tailor founded by two Canadian brothers, Alex and Ben. Our mission is to make clothes that you will love for years to come. Discover a true bespoke experience.

feeds.title: Anderson & Sheppard Blog
feeds.description: The Notebook is a web log from Savile Row tailors Anderson & Sheppard that records the training, growth and development of its apprentices. This is hoped to give visitors an insight into the cutting, tailoring and traditional craft that goes into an Anderson & Sheppard suit, as well as the apprentice programme.

feeds.title: Bucktrout Tailoring
feeds.description: Bucktrout Tailoring is a family-owned clothing label with over 50 years of craft and expertise.

feeds.title: Bespoke Edge Blog
feeds.description: The men behind the label are Ron, Ryan, and Brett. Bespoke Edge provides the absolute best in suiting and shirting for the discerning Colorado man. Ryan handles the majority of the blogging. His aim is to curate content that answers the practical style questions that so many men have. He loves researching the origins of menswear and and how to build a spectacular wedding suit.

feeds.title: A Tailor Made It
feeds.description: I am a theatrical costume cutter/tailor at North America's largest repertory theatre. I've been working in the theatre since 1986, and have the privelege of working with many of the top-notch designers in Canada, the US and the UK.

feeds.title: Fields Menswear » Suits & Tailoring
feeds.description: Fields Menswear supply an array of stylish mens designer clothing for the fashion conscious. Whether you are looking for new wardrobe staples or a new look, Fields Menswear have plenty of collections for you to choose from.

feeds.title: Apsley Tailors Blog
feeds.description: Apsley Tailors, established in 1889, offers luxury, handmade, bespoke tailoring of exceptional quality, in great speed and for excellent value.

feeds.title: Mohan's Custom Tailors
feeds.description: One of the oldest since 1971 and most Experience Tailors in Singapore. We are one of Singapore's few remaining authentic Bespoke Tailors who create Ladies and Gents Suits, Shirts and other custom made clothes by hand, which is still considered an art by Master Tailors internationally.

feeds.title: Knights & Lords Blog
feeds.description: Knights & Lords creates Bespoke suits through the Drape cut method of suit making which was originally founded by Anderson & Sheppard in Savile Row. Its Directors, Ashish & Pawan strive to open peoples Eye Of Bespoke through their craft.

feeds.title: Andrew J Musson Blog
feeds.description: Andrew J Musson Born in the beautiful City of Lincoln, as a child I grew up surrounded by tailoring as my father John Musson, up until the handover of his long running very successful tailoring business (formerly known as 'Victor Paterson'), gave me the foundation of my tailoring career.

feeds.title: Threadgold
feeds.description: A tailoring guide for busy men and women in the City who want to dress well and look good. Threadgold was created to help busy men in the city look their best. Offering both made to measure and bespoke, we visit you at the office or at home.

feeds.title: Robinson Tailors Blog
feeds.description: Robinson Tailors is a family run Business located in Alcester, Warwickshire. We hand make bespoke Jackets, Trousers & suits to our customers requirements.

feeds.title: Doherty Evans & Stott Blog
feeds.description: Dispensing personal tailoring garments and seasonal collections to the gentlemen of England's northwest. These include jackets, trouser, shirts, ties, and accessories.

feeds.title: Graham Browne Be Spoke
feeds.description: Graham Browne Bespoke Tailors are located at 12 well court ( off bow lane ) near Cheapside, London and have been in the area 43 years. Cutters Russell and Dan have a military background from their working days at Kashket & partners, so Graham browne's house cut is waisted and well fitting with high armholes but are open to suggestion.

feeds.title: 108 Bespoke
feeds.description: v is a customised clothing store with creative fashion stylists and expert tailors to create your perfect bespoke outfit. Subscribe us to get the latest trends from 108 Bespoke.

feeds.title: All Alterations Blog
feeds.description: A Custom Tailoring Blog by All Alterations.

feeds.title: Sartorial Notes
feeds.description: The publication is a leading European blog and journal about bespoke tailoring, handmade shoes, fine shirts and all those major and minor components that create true style.

feeds.title: Cad & The Dandy Savile Row Blog
feeds.description: At Cad & The Dandy we have a passion for all things tailoring. We don't over complicate things, operating from premises in Savile Row and The City, with our trained Savile Row tailors, cutters and finishers. We offer three grades of tailored suit: fully hand-stitched, half hand-stitched and machine stitched. All of our suits start with pattern creation, done by hand and retained for future orders.

feeds.title: Redwood and Feller
feeds.description: Bespoke Tailors in London since 1946. Hand crafting and custom tailoring of the finest suits, bridegroom wear, formal dress, overcoats and alterations.

feeds.title: Kinslager Tailoring Blog
feeds.description: Kinslager is a German Tailoring specialist based in Malaysia - whom offers bespoke Tailoring & Designs. In Kinslager Tailoring blog you will learn about tailor made suits or bespoke suits, ladies suits, tailored shirts, tailoring fabrics, pocket squares or other accessories or simply about anything related to tailoring and suits.

feeds.title: King & Allen
feeds.description: Founded in 2004, King & Allen are a bespoke tailoring company who create beautifully tailored suits for men and women. Every part of the suit is uniquely designed to your requirements, from the cloth and the lining to the buttons and the stitching. Read King & Allen's latest men's and women's fashion and style tips from fashion icons and discover expert designers' predictions.

feeds.title: Love Your Tailor Blog
feeds.description: Love Your Tailor is a Toronto based tailor and clothing alterations factory offering world class tailoring and alterations services to Toronto.

feeds.title: Artful Tailoring Blog
feeds.description: Artful Tailoring is the top custom tailor in Arizona that offers bespoke suits, in-house tailors, custom shirts, bridal alterations, wedding packages, and much more.

feeds.title: Zebel News
feeds.description: Zebel is a bespoke tailoring company, we specialize in tailor made garments.

feeds.title: Walter The Tailor
feeds.description: Walter the Tailor has catered to the city's most discerning ever since, altering existing wardrobe pieces, repairing favourites, and completely redesgining entire wardrobes. For men, and those women that enjoy the cut and feel of pants, suits, and jackets, Walter The Tailor can make you feel better, by looking better.

feeds.title: Alexandra Wood
feeds.description: Award-winning Savile Row designer & bespoke tailor. Made to measure & bespoke tailoring.
